name: Stadtwerke Lübeck regional data center
notes: Municipal/regional data center launched in Lübeck; sources describe redundant systems, regional customers, two 100 kW CHP units for supporting power/heat concept, rooftop PV, and server-waste-heat reuse.

name: University of Lübeck AnoMed AI data center
notes: BMFTR-funded EUR 29 million AI research data center on the university campus; 400 sqm, planned setup and commissioning in 2026, project term March 2026 through December 2027; stated compute target over 3,000 PetaFLOPS.

name: LYNET Kommunikation Lübeck
notes: Facility listings identify a LYNET data center/facility at Niels-Bohr-Ring 15 in Lübeck; company profile confirms Lübeck headquarters at that address. Treated as an operational small colocation/hosting facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: Uniq Land Langenhorn data center
notes: Proposed large data center in Langenhorn-Mönkebüll on about 5-5.5 hectares near a planned SH Netz substation; first phase reported at 150 MW, with possible later doubling to 300 MW. Municipal decision was postponed as of 2026-06-25.

name: Windcloud Enge-Sande / GreenTEC Campus data center
notes: Windcloud states its data center is on the GreenTEC Campus in Enge-Sande, Nordfriesland, powered by locally generated renewable energy; Schleswig-Holstein state page also identifies the CO2-neutral Enge-Sande data center with rooftop algae-farm heat reuse.

name: Windcloud Bramstedtlund data center expansion
notes: Trade press reported a second Windcloud data center build in Nordfriesland/Bramstedtlund after the first Enge-Sande site; facility directories list Windcloud Bramstedtlund as a data center at Am Berg, and earlier coverage cited a planned 1 MW power consumption.

name: dataR Rellingen colocation data center
notes: Large 8,500 sqm colocation data center in Rellingen/Krupunder; NDR reported construction on plan, first customer equipment moved in, test operation upcoming, EUR 80 million cost. Kreis Pinneberg Wirtschaft describes water cooling, renewable power, and 5 MW of usable waste heat.

name: Altenholz green data center proposal
notes: Kieler Nachrichten reports Gdd GmbH presented plans in the Altenholz building committee for a green data center powered partly by the Altenholz/Felm wind project; follow-up local reporting links a proposed 53 ha, roughly 60 MW solar park as another possible power source. Early-stage local proposal; capacity not disclosed.

name: Energiepark Schuby data centers / North Storage
developer: North Storage and second unnamed developer
notes: Two large data centers proposed near Schuby-West substation as part of Energiepark Schuby; NDR reports individual loads of 1.0 GW and 0.5 GW, local cooperation support, and pending state-level approval/target-deviation process. One named project is North Storage.

name: AKQUINET Norderstedt data center
notes: AKQUINET lists Norderstedt as a colocation data center awarded TÜV Rheinland Sustainable Data Center; Dataport states it commissioned Akquinet to build a secure Twin Data Center, with first procedures moved into Akquinet-built Hamburg/Norderstedt sites in 2013.

name: Stadtwerke Norderstedt data center heat-reuse project
notes: Stadtwerke Norderstedt operates a data center whose waste heat is used in the municipal district-heating system; sources report heat supply to about 1,500 homes from April 2024 and plans to expand heat recovery to another data center, targeting 5 MW of waste heat by 2030.

name: AKQUINET Itzehoe data center
notes: AKQUINET lists Itzehoe as a highly available data center with full infrastructure for flexible server and storage systems; trade press states AKQUINET operates highly available data centers at Norderstedt, Itzehoe, Hamburg-Alsterdorf, and Hamburg-Rahlstedt.
